relationships.subject: preservative-free diclofenac
relationships.evidence_quote: Mean reported pain score was significantly lower at six hours after IVI in the preservative-free diclofenac group (17.1 ± 23.0) than in the nepafenac group (26.2 ± 31.9) and the control group (27.5 ± 29.2) (p = 0.03).

key_findings: Preservative-free diclofenac gave lower pain scores at 6 h after intravitreal injection than nepafenac or control; no difference at 24 h.
